data.summary: The review data is extremely sparse and outdated. The single detailed review appears authentic, but the overall volume is suspiciously low for an established contractor. The empty 5-star review is a significant red flag. There is not enough evidence to confirm a pattern of authentic customer feedback.
fake_signals: Extremely low review volume (2) for a company in business for years
One review is empty text with a 5-star rating
No reviews on other major platforms (Angi, Houzz, Yelp)
BBB A+ rating lacks supporting complaint/review data
Google reviews are old (4 and 6 years ago) with no recent activity
authentic_signals: One detailed review mentions specific project (basement cement floors)
Review mentions future intent (garage floors next)
Reviewer is a Google Local Guide with other reviews
data.discrepancy_explanation: Insufficient review data across platforms to detect meaningful discrepancies. BBB rating is high but lacks complaint/review data.
